description:
`muster upgrade` from 0.25.0 to 0.26.0 in a window holding local panes and panes on a linked Linux devenv: after the relaunch and the devenv daemon's handoff, every local pane was in tab 1 and each devenv pane alone in its own tab ("Tab 3" ... "Tab 7"), with one `[[region]]` per devenv pane in `window-<n>.toml`. That matches 0.26.0's "a removed or unreachable pane comes back in a tab of its own" path, so the devenv probably read as unreachable during the handoff.

A daemon handoff during an upgrade should not count as a machine leaving, and a pane that comes back should return to its saved place. From tooling feedback a_2xx6GmX3f.
title: An upgrade's daemon handoff puts each devenv pane in a tab of its own
